concepts.proposed_markdown: Metronome exposes bearer-authenticated `POST /v1/invoices/void`, whose JSON body requires an invoice `id` as a UUID-formatted string and whose HTTP 200 schema returns only `data.id`. The operation description says it permanently and immediately sets the invoice status to `voided`, preventing collection, removing it from customer billing, and stopping payment processing. The response does not include the new status, and the page does not define eligible starting states, repeated-call or idempotency behavior, errors, webhooks, or downstream reconciliation. Because the separate correction guide says a Metronome void does not void a downstream invoice, do not extend this endpoint's effect to Stripe, ERP, marketplace, payment refund, A/R, tax, revenue, or ledger changes without separate evidence.
warnings: Scope the documented void effect to the Metronome invoice; this page does not establish downstream invoice cancellation or payment refund behavior.
Do not infer eligible invoice states, idempotency, error handling, webhook behavior, or accounting and reconciliation effects from the success-only schema.
The success response returns only `data.id`; it does not expose the resulting status despite the prose saying the status change is applied immediately.
